raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The Intel XPU nightly publish job (`release-docker-intel-xpu-nightly.yml`) builds two `intel/sglang-dev` images per run: one with the prebuilt `sglang-kernel-xpu` wheel and one with `sgl-kernel-xpu` main built from source. Today the wheel image's dated tag doesn't say which variant it is, and the source image uses a `-kernel-main-` suffix. This makes the kernel variant explicit in both tags.

## Modifications

Rename only the dated-tag suffix:

| Variant | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| wheel | `nightly-dev-xpu-bmg-20261020-c2e5742` | `nightly-dev-xpu-bmg-20261020-c2e5742-main-whl` |
| source | `nightly-dev-xpu-bmg-20261020-c2e5742-kernel-main-253c08a` | `nightly-dev-xpu-bmg-20261020-c2e5742-main-main-253c08a` |

- No other tag logic changes. Non-main refs keep their existing slug prefix.
- The rolling `latest` and `latest-kernel-main` tags that CI pulls are unchanged. Nothing in the repo reads the dated tags.
- Build args, kernel pinning, and push steps are unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A, CI tagging only.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

             kernel_source=wheel

             latest_tag=latest

           else
             # Pin the kernel commit so the tag names exactly what was built.
             kernel_ref=$(git ls-remote https://github.com/sgl-project/sgl-kernel-xpu.git refs/heads/main | cut -f1)
@@ -66,7 +67,7 @@ jobs:
             fi
             kernel_source=source
             latest_tag=latest-kernel-main
-            image_tag="${image_tag}-kernel-main-${kernel_ref:0:7}"
+            image_tag="${image_tag}-main-main-${kernel_ref:0:7}"
           fi
           echo "DATE=${date_tag}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
           echo "commit_hash=${commit_hash}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
